# kay

> kay is a Bun web framework. A `.kay` file is one component: TypeScript fences, then a pug-like indented template. Pages render to plain HTML strings on the server, islands run on kay's own signals and DOM runtime, and an Elysia plugin serves it all with automatic islands. Everything is typed, templates included, and `kay check` reports errors at the `.kay` line and column.

## Rules that are easy to get wrong

- Every dynamic value sits in `{}`: `a(href={url})`, `p Hello {name}`. A static attribute value is a quoted string: `a(href="/about")`.
- A signal or memo is read by calling it, `count()`, in the template as in the script; one the template names bare where its value goes is an error, `uncalled-signal`, which `kay check --fix` calls. It is written by assigning it, in both: `count = 0`, `count += step` and `count++` compile to `.set`, and `count.set(c => c * 2)` still works; assigning works on any signal a `const`, an import, a `let`, a property (`box.count = 1`) or an array element holds. Props and server data are plain values: `{title}`, not `{title()}`; a child writing its parent's state types the prop `Bindable<T>`, assigns it, and the parent passes `bind:open={open}`.
- A `for` matches its rows across renders by `item.id`, else by the item itself; rows of plain objects edited immutably keep their nodes with no key, and `key={post.slug}` names another key.
- An `await` block streams any promise it is given, `await comments`, `await data.comments`, a prop or one a component makes; a rejection before it renders crashes nothing.
- The component script exports types only. Shared values live in `.ts` modules.
- A page has no props: its data comes from its `--- server` fence.
- `window`, `document`, `localStorage` and the other globals only a browser has are read in `effect` or `onMount`, or in a component whose script fence is `--- client`; reading one while rendering throws on the server.
- Durations kay's config and server code take are seconds as a number, or a number with its unit as a string, `'250ms'`, `'30s'`, `'5m'`, `'1.5h'`, `'30d'`, `'2w'` (type `Duration` from `kay`): `cached`'s `ttl`, `revalidate`, a session's `maxAge`, `rateLimit`'s `window`, an action's `minTime`. `every`, `debounced`, `rooms.coalesce`, `sqliteRooms` and the delays of kayjs-cms and kayjs-ui take the string alone (`DurationText`), and a bare number throws. Each must be positive. `bun:test`'s timeouts and `kay/test`'s browser `timeout` are milliseconds; a store's `set(id, data, maxAge)` gets seconds.
- Indentation is spaces only, consistent within a block. Text after a tag needs one space: `p Hello`, never `p:Hello`.
- Under `kay dev`, `.kay/dev/errors.json` lists the errors the server met (compile errors, requests that threw, islands' browser errors) at their `.kay` lines: read it rather than opening the browser.
- Pug features that do not exist: `- code` lines, `#{}` and `!{}` interpolation, `+mixins`, `include`, `extends`, `block`, filters, `&attributes`, `case`, `each`, `while`, `unless`, `doctype`; a line starting with one is reported, with what kay writes instead.

## Libraries

kay's own libraries are released with kay, and each ships its `llms.txt` and `llms/` in its package: open the one a task needs.

- [kayjs-auth](packages/auth/llms.txt): sign-in with OAuth, passwords, magic links, two-factor and passkeys, bearer tokens, admin pages, organizations
- [kayjs-ui](packages/ui/llms.txt): components styled by one theme: buttons, dialogs, toasts, tables, forms, charts, layouts
- [kayjs-mail](packages/mail/llms.txt): mails written as `.kay` components, SMTP from the environment, an outbox in tests, sending through the queue
- [kayjs-cms](packages/cms/llms.txt): content edited on the page it renders, collection screens, history, uploads
- [kayjs-ai](packages/ai/llms.txt): `ask()` over Anthropic or an OpenAI-compatible server, streamed replies, tools, limits

## Docs

To build a site, read [Build a site](llms/site.md) first. The topic files below cover what it leaves out. Each opens with its common tasks, one sentence and one example apiece; the exact rules follow under Reference, one per bullet.

- [Build a site](llms/site.md): config, layout, a Markdown collection, the 404 page, islands, a form
- [Components](llms/components.md): fences, props, signals, memos, effects, generic components, `import.meta.glob`
- [Component libraries and extensions](llms/component-libraries.md): shipping components in a package, the pages, tabs and commands a library adds, naming conventions
- [Template lines](llms/templates.md): elements, attributes, events, bindings, `if`/`for`/`await`/`try`, slots, snippets
- [Head and site metadata](llms/head.md): `head` in templates, site-wide SEO defaults and social cards
- [Sitemap, favicon, offline, search and fonts](llms/sitemap-search-fonts.md): sitemap, robots.txt, favicon, manifest, offline, search, fonts
- [Styles and assets](llms/styles-and-assets.md): component styles and Tailwind, `public/`, imported files, wasm and workers
- [Images and icons](llms/images.md): imported and responsive images, share cards, resizing stored or remote images, Iconify icons
- [Islands](llms/islands.md): props, hydration, shared and persisted state, transitions, context
- [Browser-only code](llms/browser-only.md): browser-only components, browser globals on the server, server globals in the browser
- [Navigation and pages kay does not serve](llms/navigation.md): in-place navigation, islands kept across pages, forms posting in place
- [Pages and routing](llms/routing.md): file-based routes, params, layouts, the server fence and `ctx`
- [Endpoint files, redirects, rewrites, base path](llms/routing-endpoints-and-base.md): `llms.txt.ts` exporting `GET`, `redirects`, `rewrite`, `base`
- [Prerendering and static export](llms/prerendering.md): prerendered pages, revalidation, server islands, static export
- [Content collections](llms/content.md): Markdown, JSON and YAML collections against a schema, entries as pages, feeds
- [Loaded collections and preview mode](llms/content-cms.md): loaders for a CMS or a database, preview mode for drafts
- [Edit mode and the CMS editor](llms/content-edit.md): edit mode's markers on a page, the editor island, `showDraft`
- [Locales](llms/locales.md): locale prefixes, typed messages, number and date formatting, redirecting a visitor
- [Caching and streaming](llms/rendering.md): caching pages and data, streaming with `await`, `renderToString`
- [Actions](llms/actions.md): form posts that work without JavaScript, typed by a schema: errors, files, redirects
- [Calling actions from islands](llms/actions-from-islands.md): `pending()`, `track()`, streaming answers, optimistic changes
- [Schemas](llms/schemas.md): one schema for the server, its type read by islands
- [Protecting actions and limiting requests](llms/action-protection.md): cross-site posts, honeypot, minimum time, proof of work
- [Rate limits](llms/rate-limits.md): `rateLimit` on actions, guards and API routes, keys, stores
- [Stored files](llms/files.md): uploads on disk or in S3, links, resizing, private links, progress
- [Locals, sessions and guards](llms/server.md): `ctx.locals`, cookie sessions and stores, `_guard.ts` route guards
- [Environment variables](llms/environment.md): a typed `defineEnv`, variables read by islands
- [API routes](llms/api-routes.md): Elysia modules under `src/api/`, CORS, OpenAPI, and the MCP endpoint
- [Calling API routes from islands](llms/api-from-islands.md): typed route reads, server-sent events
- [Live values, cached values and presence](llms/live-values.md): `live()`, presence, websockets
- [Rooms](llms/rooms.md): groups of websocket connections, shared state, a snapshot on join
- [Testing](llms/testing.md): `kay/test`, pages and actions in `bun test`
- [Test databases and setup](llms/testing-setup.md): `kay/test/preload`, a database per file, seeds
- [Testing in a browser](llms/testing-browser.md): `site.open`, headless Chrome
- [Checks and lints](llms/checks.md): what `kay check` verifies, ESLint on `.kay` files
- [Lints and warnings](llms/lints.md): every lint at its default level, changing a level, allowing one, applying its fix
- [Errors](llms/errors.md): the codes of the errors that are no lint, and where each fix is documented
- [Project setup and scaffolding](llms/project.md): `kay.config.ts`, tsconfig, editor setup, migrating from Astro
- [kay new and kay add](llms/project-new-and-add.md): presets, features, adding one to a project
- [The dev server](llms/dev-server.md): `kay dev` and its error page
- [The dev tool](llms/dev-tool.md): its tabs and the problems it lists
